name: Pipes Carrying Water From Source To Field-Pulses ISPOM
benefit:
**Financial Assistance:** Subsidy on 50% cost or ₹15,000/- for water carrying pipes upto 800m; all types of pipes(PVC HDPE etc.,) and all size as per the requirement of the farmer.
<br>
_eligibility_text:
- The beneficiary should be a Farmer.
  - The beneficiary should be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
